inflict.en: Careless words can inflict lasting emotional harm on other people.
inflict.zh: 不經思考的話語可能對他人造成長久的情緒傷害。

insane.en: The novel portrays the rumor as insane rather than believable.
insane.zh: 這本小說把那個謠言描寫得荒謬而不可信。

intake.en: The school recorded a larger student intake than expected this year.
intake.zh: 學校今年記錄到的學生入學人數比預期更多。

integration.en: The project promotes integration between science lessons and local environmental studies.
integration.zh: 這個計畫促進科學課程與在地環境研究的整合。

integrity.en: Academic integrity means completing your own work and citing sources properly.
integrity.zh: 學術誠信意味著自己完成作業並正確引用資料來源。

intellect.en: Her curiosity and intellect made the discussion lively and thoughtful.
intellect.zh: 她的好奇心與才智讓討論變得生動而有深度。

intellectual.en: The debate offered an intellectual challenge to students in the class.
intellectual.zh: 這場辯論為班上學生帶來知識層面的挑戰。

intensify.en: Dark clouds began to intensify as the afternoon storm approached.
intensify.zh: 隨著午後暴風雨接近，烏雲開始加劇。

intensity.en: The intensity of the rain surprised everyone waiting at the station.
intensity.zh: 雨勢的強度讓在車站等候的每個人都很驚訝。

intensive.en: She joined an intensive language course during the summer vacation.
intensive.zh: 她在暑假參加了一門密集語言課程。

intent.en: His intent was to explain the problem clearly, not criticize anyone.
intent.zh: 他的用意是清楚解釋問題，而不是批評任何人。

intention.en: My intention is to finish the report before Friday afternoon.
intention.zh: 我的打算是在星期五下午以前完成報告。

interaction.en: Classroom interaction helps students practice speaking and listening skills naturally.
interaction.zh: 課堂互動能幫助學生自然練習口說與聽力能力。

interfere.en: Background noise can interfere with concentration during a difficult reading task.
interfere.zh: 背景噪音可能會干擾進行困難閱讀任務時的專注力。

interference.en: Radio interference made the emergency announcement difficult to hear clearly.
interference.zh: 無線電干擾讓緊急廣播很難聽清楚。

interior.en: The museum interior was bright, quiet, and easy to explore.
interior.zh: 博物館內部明亮、安靜，而且很容易參觀。

interpreter.en: An interpreter helped the visitors understand the guide's explanation accurately.
interpreter.zh: 口譯員幫助訪客準確理解導覽員的說明。

interruption.en: A brief interruption delayed the presentation by only a few minutes.
interruption.zh: 一次短暫的中斷只讓簡報延遲了幾分鐘。

intersection.en: The library stands near the busy intersection beside the city park.
intersection.zh: 圖書館位在市立公園旁那個繁忙的十字路口附近。

intervention.en: Early teacher intervention helped the group resolve its disagreement peacefully.
intervention.zh: 老師及早介入，幫助小組和平解決意見分歧。

intimidate.en: A difficult question should not intimidate you into giving up immediately.
intimidate.zh: 一道困難的題目不該嚇得你立刻放棄。

intonation.en: Changing your intonation can make a spoken sentence sound more natural.
intonation.zh: 改變語調可以讓口語句子聽起來更自然。

intrigue.en: Ancient maps continue to intrigue students who enjoy history and geography.
intrigue.zh: 古老地圖仍持續吸引喜愛歷史與地理的學生。

intrude.en: Please knock before entering so you do not intrude on the meeting.
intrude.zh: 進入前請先敲門，以免打擾會議。

intruder.en: The alarm warned the staff that an intruder had entered the closed building.
intruder.zh: 警報提醒工作人員有人闖入已關閉的建築物。

intuition.en: Her intuition told her to check the calculation one more time.
intuition.zh: 她的直覺告訴她要再檢查一次計算。

invade.en: The history lesson explains why one empire tried to invade another region.
invade.zh: 歷史課解釋了為何某個帝國曾試圖入侵另一個地區。

invaluable.en: The teacher's feedback was invaluable when I revised my final essay.
invaluable.zh: 我修改期末作文時，老師的回饋非常寶貴。

invariably.en: The bus invariably becomes crowded during the morning rush hour.
invariably.zh: 這班公車在早晨尖峰時段總是會變得很擁擠。

invasion.en: The documentary examines the invasion from several historical perspectives.
invasion.zh: 這部紀錄片從多個歷史角度探討那次入侵。

inventor.en: The young inventor demonstrated a simple device at the science fair.
inventor.zh: 這位年輕發明家在科展展示了一個簡單裝置。

inventory.en: The store checks its inventory before ordering more school supplies.
inventory.zh: 商店在訂購更多文具前會先盤點庫存。

investigation.en: The investigation focused on how the equipment failure had occurred.
investigation.zh: 調查重點放在設備故障是如何發生的。

investigator.en: The investigator carefully reviewed the records before writing the final report.
investigator.zh: 調查人員在撰寫最終報告前仔細檢視了紀錄。

invitation.en: I received an invitation to attend the school's science exhibition next week.
invitation.zh: 我收到邀請，下週參加學校的科學展覽。

involvement.en: Student involvement made the charity event more organized and energetic.
involvement.zh: 學生的參與讓公益活動更有組織也更有活力。

iron.en: The bridge contains iron parts that require regular inspection and maintenance.
iron.zh: 這座橋含有需要定期檢查與維護的鐵製部件。

ironic.en: It was ironic that the rain stopped just after we went indoors.
ironic.zh: 很諷刺的是，我們一進室內雨就停了。

irony.en: The story uses irony to show the difference between appearance and reality.
irony.zh: 這個故事運用反諷來呈現表象與現實的差異。

irritable.en: Lack of sleep can make someone irritable during a long school day.
irritable.zh: 睡眠不足可能讓人在漫長的上課日變得易怒。

irritate.en: Repeated tapping sounds can irritate people who are trying to concentrate.
irritate.zh: 反覆的敲擊聲可能會惹惱正在專心的人。

isle.en: The small isle appears on maps as a protected natural area.
isle.zh: 這座小島在地圖上標示為受保護的自然區域。

isolation.en: The research station operates in isolation during the coldest winter months.
isolation.zh: 研究站在最寒冷的冬季月份處於與外界隔離的狀態。

it.en: It became clear that the team needed a better plan.
it.zh: 事情變得很清楚：這個團隊需要一個更好的計畫。

itch.en: The wool sweater caused a slight itch on his arm.
itch.zh: 那件羊毛毛衣讓他的手臂有一點發癢。

its.en: The school updated its website before the new semester began.
its.zh: 學校在新學期開始前更新了它的網站。

ivory.en: The museum display explains why illegal ivory trade threatens elephants.
ivory.zh: 博物館展示說明了非法象牙交易為何威脅大象。

ivy.en: Green ivy covered part of the old brick wall near the garden.
ivy.zh: 綠色常春藤覆蓋了花園旁老磚牆的一部分。

jade.en: The museum displayed a jade carving from an ancient collection.
jade.zh: 博物館展出了一件來自古代收藏的玉雕。

jail.en: The history book describes how the activist spent months in jail.
jail.zh: 歷史課本描述了那名社會運動者曾在監獄中待了數月。

jam.en: Traffic jam conditions delayed several buses near the station this morning.
jam.zh: 今天早上車站附近的塞車情況讓好幾班公車延誤。

janitor.en: The janitor opened the classroom early so the club could prepare.
janitor.zh: 工友提早打開教室，讓社團可以準備。

jar.en: She stored the dried beans in a clean glass jar.
jar.zh: 她把乾燥豆子裝在乾淨的玻璃罐裡。

jasmine.en: The jasmine near the gate filled the evening air with fragrance.
jasmine.zh: 大門旁的茉莉花讓傍晚空氣充滿香氣。

jaw.en: The diagram labels the jaw as part of the human skull.
jaw.zh: 圖表把下顎標示為人類頭骨的一部分。

jazz.en: The music club performed a short jazz piece at the festival.
jazz.zh: 音樂社在校慶表演了一小段爵士樂。

jealous.en: He felt jealous at first but later congratulated his teammate sincerely.
jealous.zh: 他起初感到嫉妒，但後來真心祝賀隊友。

jealousy.en: The novel explores how jealousy can damage trust between close friends.
jealousy.zh: 這本小說探討嫉妒如何破壞好友之間的信任。

jeans.en: She wore jeans and a school jacket during the field trip.
jeans.zh: 她在校外教學時穿著牛仔褲和學校外套。

jeep.en: A jeep carried researchers along the rough road to the station.
jeep.zh: 一輛吉普車載著研究人員沿崎嶇道路前往研究站。

jelly.en: The dessert included fruit, jelly, and a small scoop of yogurt.
jelly.zh: 這份甜點包含水果、果凍和一小球優格。

jet.en: The jet crossed the sky and disappeared behind the clouds.
jet.zh: 那架噴射機飛越天空後消失在雲層後方。

jewel.en: The crown's central jewel was displayed under protective glass.
jewel.zh: 王冠中央的寶石被放在防護玻璃下展示。

jewelry.en: The exhibit features traditional jewelry from several different cultures.
jewelry.zh: 這項展覽展示來自數種不同文化的傳統珠寶。

jingle.en: A short jingle played before the school radio announcement began.
jingle.zh: 校園廣播開始前播放了一小段廣告歌。

jockey.en: The article describes how a jockey trains for professional horse racing.
jockey.zh: 這篇文章描述騎師如何為職業賽馬接受訓練。

jog.en: They jog around the track at an easy pace after class.
jog.zh: 他們下課後以輕鬆的速度繞操場慢跑。

joint.en: The two schools announced a joint science project for next semester.
joint.zh: 兩所學校宣布下學期將進行一項聯合科學計畫。

journal.en: She kept a journal to record observations from the biology project.
journal.zh: 她用日誌記錄生物專題的觀察結果。

journalism.en: The club introduced students to basic journalism and responsible reporting.
journalism.zh: 社團向學生介紹新聞工作的基本概念與負責任的報導方式。

journalist.en: The journalist interviewed several experts before publishing the article.
journalist.zh: 那名記者在發表文章前訪問了多位專家。

journey.en: Their train journey across the island lasted nearly six hours.
journey.zh: 他們搭火車橫越全島的旅程持續了將近六小時。

joyful.en: The students gave a joyful cheer when the results were announced.
joyful.zh: 結果公布時，學生們發出歡樂的歡呼聲。

judge.en: The science fair judge asked careful questions about the experiment.
judge.zh: 科展評審仔細詢問了關於實驗的問題。

judgment.en: Good judgment is important when evaluating information found online.
judgment.zh: 評估網路資訊時，良好的判斷力很重要。

juice.en: The cafeteria served orange juice with breakfast this morning.
juice.zh: 餐廳今天早上早餐供應柳橙汁。

junction.en: The hikers stopped at the trail junction to check the map.
junction.zh: 健行者在步道交會處停下來查看地圖。

junior.en: The junior students organized a welcome event for new classmates.
junior.zh: 較低年級的學生為新同學舉辦了歡迎活動。

jury.en: The civics lesson explained how a jury works in some legal systems.
jury.zh: 公民課解釋了陪審團在某些法律制度中的運作方式。

justice.en: The class discussed justice and fairness in several historical cases.
justice.zh: 班上討論了數個歷史案例中的正義與公平。

juvenile.en: The article examines juvenile behavior from an educational perspective.
juvenile.zh: 這篇文章從教育角度探討青少年行為。

keen.en: She has a keen interest in astronomy and often visits the observatory.
keen.zh: 她對天文學有濃厚興趣，經常參觀天文台。

kernel.en: Each corn kernel contains stored energy for the developing plant.
kernel.zh: 每一顆玉米粒都含有供植物生長使用的儲存能量。

keyboard.en: The computer keyboard stopped working during the first lesson.
keyboard.zh: 電腦鍵盤在第一節課時停止運作。

kidney.en: The biology textbook includes a diagram showing the human kidney.
kidney.zh: 生物課本附有一張顯示人類腎臟的圖。

kilogram.en: The package weighs less than one kilogram according to the scale.
kilogram.zh: 根據磅秤顯示，這個包裹重量不到一公斤。

kilometer.en: The walking trail continues for another kilometer beyond the bridge.
kilometer.zh: 這條步道過橋後還會再延伸一公里。

kindergarten.en: The school shares a playground with the nearby kindergarten.
kindergarten.zh: 這所學校和附近的幼兒園共用一座操場。

kingdom.en: The history chapter describes how the ancient kingdom expanded through trade.
kingdom.zh: 歷史章節描述那個古代王國如何透過貿易擴張。

kit.en: Each group received a science kit for the classroom experiment.
kit.zh: 每一組都拿到一套供課堂實驗使用的科學材料組。

kite.en: The children flew a kite in the open field after school.
kite.zh: 孩子們放學後在空地上放風箏。

kitten.en: The shelter found a home for every rescued kitten that week.
kitten.zh: 收容所在那一週為每隻獲救的小貓找到了新家。

kiwi.en: She added sliced kiwi to the fruit bowl for breakfast.
kiwi.zh: 她在早餐水果碗裡加了切片奇異果。

kneel.en: Students kneel briefly to examine the small plants near the path.
kneel.zh: 學生短暫跪下來觀察步道旁的小植物。

knit.en: My grandmother can knit a warm scarf in a few evenings.
knit.zh: 我祖母幾個晚上就能織出一條保暖圍巾。
